## Workload

Marcus Bell completed 739 reads during the quarter, recording 399 hours of work. This equates to 1.9 reads per hour. The workload review records the total activity and the corresponding time spent, providing a clear basis for assessing throughput. The figures are presented together to support consistent monitoring of the grader’s work across the review period.

## Quality

A further 69 reads were checked as part of the quality review. The recorded agreement was 71.0 per cent. Priya Anand reviewed the results and considered the workload and quality information together. The review confirms the reported activity, the number of reads checked, and the level of agreement between the grader and reviewer.
